name: Core.InitsUpdatesComm
candidate:
theorem InitsUpdatesComm
  {P : PureExpr} {σ σ' σ'' : SemanticStore P}
  {ks ks' : List P.Ident} {vs vs' : List P.Expr} :
  UpdateStates σ ks vs σ' →
  InitStates σ' ks' vs' σ'' →
  ∃ σ₁,
    σ₁ = (updatedStates σ ks' vs') ∧
    InitStates σ ks' vs' σ₁ ∧
    UpdateStates σ₁ ks vs σ'' := by
  intro Hup Hinit
  have Hndef := UpdateStatesNotDefMonotone' (InitStatesNotDefined Hinit) Hup
  have Hdef := UpdateStatesDefined' Hup
  refine ⟨_, rfl, updatedStatesInit (InitStatesLength Hinit) Hndef (InitStatesNodup Hinit), ?_⟩
  rw [InitStatesUpdated Hinit, UpdateStatesUpdated Hup]
  unfold updatedStates
  rw [updatedStatesComm]
  · exact updatedStatesUpdate (UpdateStatesLength Hup)
      (updatedStatesDefMonotone Hdef)
  · rw [List.unzip_zip (UpdateStatesLength Hup),
      List.unzip_zip (InitStatesLength Hinit)]
    intro k hk hk'
    simpa [Hndef k hk'] using Hdef k hk
